source.title: An integrative theory of locus coeruleus-norepinephrine function: adaptive gain and optimal performance.

confidence_rationale: Canonical, heavily-cited integrative theory grounded in monkey neurophysiology + modeling. Directly states the tonic LC-NE mode (the noise-floor substrate MECH-313 names) is engaged when task utility WANES and the phasic mode (exploitation) when decision utility is high, with ACC/OFC monitoring utility and driving the mode. This grounds a STATE-CONDITIONED, utility-modulated tonic exploration signal -- which is the biological warrant for refining MECH-313 toward NoisyNet's state-dependent, self-annealing noise. Confidence held below 0.85 because it is a review/theory (not a single decisive experiment) and because it supports the state-conditioned REFINEMENT, not MECH-313's currently-registered state-INDEPENDENT form.
failure_signatures: MECH-313 as registered describes a STATE-INDEPENDENT noise floor; Aston-Jones & Cohen's adaptive-gain theory holds that the LC-NE tonic exploration signal is itself conditioned on (and modulated by) task utility, so a state-independent floor is a biologically incomplete instantiation of the LC-NE mechanism MECH-313 cites.

mapping.source_claim_statement: LC neurons exhibit phasic (exploitation, driven by task-related decision outcomes) and tonic (exploration, engaged when task utility wanes -> disengagement and search for alternatives) modes; ACC and OFC monitor task-related utility and drive these LC modes to optimize utility over short and long timescales.
mapping.ree_translation: The LC-NE tonic mode is REE's MECH-313 stochastic_noise_floor substrate. The paper warrants the CDQ-002 refinement: the floor should be STATE-CONDITIONED (tracks task utility/uncertainty) and SELF-ANNEALING (suppressed toward phasic exploitation as utility/certainty rises) -- the property NoisyNet's learned, state-dependent parametric noise supplies and MECH-313's current state-independent post-softmax temperature lacks.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The paper grounds state-conditioning at the systems/utility level (ACC/OFC -> LC mode switching), not at the parameter-noise level NoisyNet uses; the mapping from 'tonic-vs-phasic mode' to 'learned per-parameter sigma' is an analogy, and the paper does not address whether such a floor propagates through to a committed/argmax action (the REE-side V3-EXQ-687 propagation question).
mapping.source_context: Monkey neurophysiology + computational modeling; integrative review (2005).

confidence_components.notes: High source quality (canonical review). Mapping fidelity moderate: grounds state-conditioning/utility-modulation strongly but at a different level of description than the parametric-noise mechanism. Transfer risk moderate (monkey systems neuroscience -> REE selection pathway).
